html:
Visit Dong Giang Heaven Gate, you will conquer the height of 1500m above sea level from the gate of heaven, you will see the scenery from the rice fields, to the corn fields in the distance, the villages hidden in the misty fog, exuding a unique beauty in the mountainous region.

Dong Giang Heaven Gate scenic area is located in Quang Nam and about 120km from the center of Da Nang city, Dong Giang Heaven Gate is a place with majestic mountain scenery, especially mountain climbing, trekking, swimming activities are chosen by many tourists for peaceful moments in the mountains and forests.

Coming to Dong Giang Heaven Gate, visitors will encounter natural streams, steep cliffs, unique caves inside with beautiful stalactites such as: Ngoc De Cave, Cong Troi Cave, Tien Cung Cave…

The most beautiful is Tien Cung Cave with 9 large and small caves, with waterfalls flowing all year round creating colorful natural stalactites, looking very eye-catching in a relatively cool climate. If you have the opportunity to go on a tour to Da Nang, visit Tien Cung Cave and admire the natural beauty that nature has bestowed upon this place.

In addition, when traveling to Dong Giang Heaven Gate, you will also be immersed in the wild natural scenery in the middle of the mountains and forests, taking you from one surprise to another.

The most interesting thing that many young people come to Dong Giang Heaven Gate is the camping spot next to the peaceful stream, especially when traveling in large groups or groups of friends, tourists can participate in team building games, mountain climbing, SUP rowing, bathing in the stream… which will bring visitors the most enjoyable feeling in the Central region.

In addition, visitors can also visit the Dragon Egg Waterfall, the bonbon forest park, 7 bridges across the Ngan River, the fossil dinosaur area… promising to bring visitors the most enjoyable vacation.

It can be said that Dong Giang Heaven Gate is a place with a cool climate all year round, with mountain ranges, streams, and caves that are beautiful check-in spots. No matter what angle you stand at, visitors can capture beautiful photos for themselves.

Especially when traveling to Dong Giang Heaven Gate, visitors can also enjoy rustic dishes with the rich flavor of the mountains and forests and specialties of the Co Tu people and participate in unique cultural festivals.

Co Tu dishes in Da Nang

The delicious dishes of the Co Tu people include grilled fish, bamboo rice, buffalo croissant, dried beef jerky, grass-fed pork cooked with wild pepper, rock snails cooked with lemongrass…

The dishes of the Co Tu people are very elaborately prepared, from the available ingredients of the mountainous homeland, then processed, especially on the day of the festival, the food is presented very eye-catchingly.

All the dishes prepared by the Co Tu people are very attractive, including grilled fish, bamboo rice, buffalo croissant, dried beef jerky… and drinks such as Ta Vat wine, sticky rice wine… all the dishes look very simple but very attractive.

It can be said that this is not only a daily dish but also shows the culture, customs and practices of the Co Tu people, a culture that seems to have an exchange between all things and the natural landscape of the mountains and forests.

All dishes of the Co Tu people in Quang Nam will show traditional culture, dishes are often simply prepared such as grilled, boiled, smoked with spices such as wild pepper, roasted leaves will give off a strong aroma.

So let’s travel to Da Nang with Vietlook Travel today and visit Dong Giang Heaven Gate to visit the natural beauty, streams, caves, special festivals and unique cuisine that will bring visitors the most enjoyable vacation.
